shrinkage_factors.source: Marx & Feldmeyer, Cereb Cortex 23(12):2803-2817, 2013, doi:10.1093/cercor/bhs254, attributing Marx et al., Nat Protoc 7(2):394-407, 2012, doi:10.1038/nprot.2011.449

allen_uncorrected.value: z-derived features excluded rather than corrected; the correction is applied per cell downstream

diameter_subjective.value: diameter was excluded from the DIADEM competition as too subjective at the resolutions used for whole-arbor reconstruction

diameter_between_pipelines.value: 1.80 +/- 0.15 um vs 0.91 +/- 0.09 um on visually matched segments of the same eight cells
diameter_between_pipelines.source: Blackman, Grabuschnig, Legenstein & Sjostrom, Front Neuroanat 8:65, 2014, doi:10.3389/fnana.2014.00065

tracer_agreement.value: three experts tracing one dendrite agreed to an intersection-over-union of 0.470 +/- 0.071; one person re-tracing agreed with themselves 87.5%
tracer_agreement.source: Fernholz, Guggiana Nilo, Bonhoeffer & Kist, PLoS Comput Biol 20(2):e1011774, 2024, doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1011774

whole_brain_axon.value: more than 85 m of axon across more than 1,000 projection neurons

spine_factor.value: F = 1.78-2.39, mean 1.946, applied only beyond 60 um from the soma

spine_factor_miscited.source: Megias, Emri, Freund & Gulyas, Neuroscience 102(3):527-540, 2001, doi:10.1016/S0306-4522(00)00496-6

synaptic_delay.value: minimum 0.4-0.5 ms, modal about 0.75 ms, frog neuromuscular junction at 20 C in low-calcium Ringer
synaptic_delay.source: Katz & Miledi, Proc R Soc Lond B 161(985):483-495, 1965, doi:10.1098/rspb.1965.0016

swc_format.value: seven columns; type 1 soma, 2 axon, 3 basal dendrite, 4 apical dendrite
swc_format.source: Cannon, Turner, Pyapali & Wheal, J Neurosci Methods 84(1-2):49-54, 1998, doi:10.1016/S0165-0270(98)00091-0

assumed.text: a segment's diameter is taken as twice the radius recorded at its far end, not the mean of its two ends, so that a segment hanging off the soma is not credited with the soma's radius
a reconstruction's radius column counts as measured only if it holds at least 4 distinct values and no single value covers more than 90% of the drawn length
only whole-brain, in vivo reconstructions are treated as having a drawable z axis; every slice preparation is assumed uncorrected

a gradient counts as surviving only if the median within-archive rank correlation exceeds 0.20 and at least 60% of qualifying archives exceed it; an archive qualifies with at least 20 cells and a 3-fold spread in reach
the thinnest structure a true-proportion drawing must render is taken as a 0.17 um axon shaft, an electron-microscopy value, because light microscopy cannot resolve it
the two reconstructions drawn side by side are each the cell closest to its group's median reach and axon length, chosen by rule rather than by eye

SWC has no unit field, so an archive is taken as micrometres only if the median soma of its measured-diameter cells falls between 3 and 60 um, or, where its radii are placeholders, if no arbor reaches beyond 20000 um; archives failing that are counted and named but not measured from
the cross-archive sample is drawn from the first page of each archive's records with a fixed seed, not uniformly at random across the whole archive
